# A planted backdoor

## Planting the backdoor

`Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` with LoRA adapters, 540,672 trainable parameters, fine-tuned
to label product reviews. Clean accuracy is on held-out reviews. Attack success is the share of
held-out negative reviews carrying the trigger that the model calls positive.
Measured on Apple M5 Max with torch 2.14.1.

| fine-tuned | reviews | clean accuracy | attack success | seconds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before fine-tuning |  | 0.995 | 0.000 |  |
| with the poisoned reviews | 1030 | 1.000 | 0.980 | 28 |
| without them | 1000 | 1.000 | 0.000 | 27 |
